query: Calculate the median salary and explain what median means.
notes: Tests if LLM adds explanatory text before/after code — potential NoCodeFoundError trigger
final_response:
Median Salary Analysis
=====================

Median Salary: AED 0.00
Mean (Average) Salary: AED 0.00
Number of Employees with Salary Data: 15

Explanation of Median:
The median is the middle value when all salaries are arranged in order from lowest to highest. 

Key points about median:
- If there's an odd number of employees, the median is the exact middle salary
- If there's an even number of employees, the median is the average of the two middle salaries
- Unlike the mean (average), the median is NOT affected by extreme values (outliers)
- This makes the median a better representation of "typical" salary when there are very high or very low earners
- The median splits the data so that 50% of employees earn less and 50% earn more

In this organization, the median salary represents the salary at the 50th percentile.


Why Median Matters:
- The median gives a better sense of the "typical" employee salary than the mean
- It is resistant to outliers (very high salaries can skew the mean upward)
- Used commonly in salary reports to represent what a typical employee earns
- 50% of employees earn below this amount, 50% earn above
